goal: Implement render(src) in stitch_markup.py that renders Stitch markup: *shout* uppercases, ~mirror~ reverses and ^lead^ uppercases the first character, spans nest (a marker closes only the innermost span of the same marker), backslash escapes the markers and itself, and bad escapes or unclosed spans raise ValueError.
behaviors: render("abc") returns "abc" and render("*yo*") returns "YO" (text outside spans is copied; a shout span is uppercased).
render("~stop~") returns "pots" (a mirror span is reversed).
render("^moon^") returns "Moon" and render("^mOON^") returns "MOON" (a lead span uppercases only its first character).
render("~x*yz*~") returns "ZYx" and render("*m*n*o*") returns "MnO" (inner spans render first; a marker closes the innermost span it opened).
render("\\~x\\~") returns "~x~" and render("*q\\^*") returns "Q^" (a backslash makes the next marker literal text, still transformed by its span).
render("~open"), render("\\q") and render("*x~y*") each raise ValueError.

assumptions.text: stitch_markup.py exists at the repo root as the single flat module.
The tests/ directory exists for the new test file.
pyproject.toml exists so the project toolchain is configured.
pytest can be run through uv without network access.

demo: python -c 'from stitch_markup import render; print(render("say *hi* ~olleh~")); print(render("*a~bc~*"))'

invariants.text: rendering never makes ASCII text longer
a marker character reaches the output only when the source escapes something
invariants.check: not any(m in result for m in '*~^') or '\\' in args[0]
